items.title: Why Is BlackRock (BLK) Backing A Bigger Push Into Organics Recycling?
items.summary: BlackRock (NYSE:BLK) backed Vanguard Renewables is acquiring Generate Upcycle’s North American organics recycling operations. The deal expands Vanguard Renewables’ network of organics recycling facilities across the US and Canada. The acquisition adds further exposure for BlackRock to organics recycling and renewable energy infrastructure through its interest in Vanguard Renewables. items.title: Apollo limits redemptions as withdrawal requests hit 14.7% - Bloomberg

items.title: If You Own IBIT, This Bitcoin Fund’s 13% Yield Deserves a Second Look
